method.inputs: Exactly 14 existing compatibility artifacts plus IRON55/57 and WATCH40/51/60. Original bytes and previous provenance remain untouched; no historical generation is executed.
method.continuation: Simulation-only passive player: ordinary endTurn with current rules and AI until a winner is recorded. No player commands, grants, edited state or old-future equality requirement.
method.reload: At every step, JSON-copy the uninterrupted current state, execute ordinary endTurn once on each, compare return values and entire next JSON, and validate both balances/states.
method.preservation: Whole input JSON remains identical after frozen validation and read-only projections. Existing paid queue receipts retain cost/work while the same queue remains active; retained old reports remain byte-identical and do not acquire round traces.
method.limits: 19 artifact checks include related and byte-identical historical snapshots; they are not independent games or a win-rate sample. Completed imports remain terminal. Simulation outcomes are not continuations played by a human.
